text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)— Thunderous cheers 
erupt from the grandstands for the 
Umamusume who waged a fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A match where both gave it everything they 
had. Cheval Grand and Kitasan Black 
naturally broke into smiles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Cheval Grand is swarmed by 
reporters after putting on a brilliant 
performance, but she answers their 
questions more positively than ever 
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the conversation, the Takarazuka 
Kinen came up. Feeling the weight of the 
fans' expectations, Cheval Grand declared 
her entry—the next target was set!
